# RealExports

Unmodified solution files exported from real Dataverse environments. Each one is used by `RealExportImportTests` (Xrmd.Integration.Tests).

`OpenProject365_1_0_1_1.zip` is not in the public copy of the repository: the tests that read it are skipped there
(`[OpenProject365Fact]`, `tests/Shared/PrivateFixtures.cs`).

| file | content | origin |
|---|---|---|
| `OpenProject365_1_0_1_1.zip` | Unmanaged solution OpenProject365 1.0.1.1, publisher pwbitItalia (prefix `op365`): 31 tables, 1 plug-in assembly (75 types, .NET Framework 4.6.2), 108 steps on Create/Update/Delete/Retrieve/RetrieveMultiple/Associate, 27 custom APIs with their parameters, PCF controls, web resources, environment variable definitions (no values), a Copilot agent | Exported by Power Builders from its own Dataverse environment (version 9.2.26102), 2026-11-10. Power Builders' own customizations, no real data: allowed by legal guardrails §8. Checked before commit: no environment variable values, no secrets, no e-mail addresses; the plug-in assembly is Power Builders' own and contains no Microsoft assembly (it references the SDK, which `xrmd sdk install` provides). |
| `xrmdWfTest_1_0_0_2.zip` | Unmanaged solution xrmdWfTest 1.0.0.2, publisher `xrmv` (prefix `xrmv`): table `xrmv_order` (`xrmv_amount` decimal, `xrmv_status` choice, `xrmv_accountid` lookup to account) and five classic processes on it, all Draft: `Child` (real-time child workflow, stop), `OnCreate` (real-time on create: create a task, start `Child`), `OnUpdate` (background on update of `xrmv_status`: wait, send an email), `New business rule` (entity scope), `Recalculate` (action bound to `xrmv_order`) | Exported by Power Builders from a licensed Dataverse environment (version 9.2.26102), 2026-11-12, as the plan 2.14 parity export (ruling W25). Power Builders' own content with invented data: allowed by legal guardrails §8. Checked before commit: no e-mail addresses, no secrets, no customer content; the only foreign id is the source environment's Euro `transactioncurrency` in `OnUpdate`'s email step. Its XAML files are also extracted byte for byte in `tests/fixtures/workflows/real`. **It is the plan 2.14 parity solution** (Task 9, ruling R1; no separate `XrmverseWorkflowParity` export was made): `WorkflowParityTests` and the `ServiceClient_parity_*` acceptance tests import it unmodified. Checked again for Task 9: the zip holds no `sdkmessage` component, no web resource, no plug-in assembly, and no e-mail address; the effects its acceptance tests assert are read from its XAML, not recorded on Dataverse (checklist step 2). |
| `xrmCalcTest_1_0_0_4.zip` | Unmanaged solution xrmCalcTest 1.0.0.4, publisher `xrmv` (prefix `xrmv`): the `account` columns `xrmv_budget` (currency) and four rollup columns (`xrmv_lastorder`, `xrmv_ordercount`, `xrmv_ordertotal`, `xrmv_treebudget`), and the table `xrmv_calcorder` with its simple columns (`xrmv_code`, `xrmv_amount`, `xrmv_price`, `xrmv_qty`, `xrmv_status`, `xrmv_startedon`, `xrmv_duedate`, `xrmv_accountid` lookup to account), 27 calculated columns (one per function and shape of plan 2.12a, question Q1, each with its XAML in `Formulas/xrmv_calcorder-<column>.xaml`) and three Power Fx formula columns (sharing `Formulas/xrmv_calcorder-FormulaDefinitions.yaml`) | Exported by Power Builders from a licensed Dataverse environment (version 9.2.26112.137), 2026-11-16, as the plan 2.12a parity export (ruling K2). Power Builders' own customizations with invented data: allowed by legal guardrails §8. Checked before commit: no e-mail addresses, no secrets, no customer content, no workflow, web resource, plug-in assembly or `sdkmessage` component; the only GUIDs are ids of forms, views and their cells and controls; `transactioncurrency` appears only as the schema of the table's currency lookup, with no id. Its calculated XAML files are also extracted byte for byte in `tests/fixtures/calculated/real`, with the values Dataverse showed for invented records (ids of the source environment removed). `CalculatedParityTests` and `ServiceClient_calculated_acceptance` import it without its rollup and formula columns (2.12b, 2.12c); as it is, it is refused with the roadmap texts. |
